# Klaviyo – AI Content Guidance File
> Klaviyo is a B2C CRM platform for email, SMS, WhatsApp, marketing automation, customer data, and analytics. This file points LLMs to the most reliable Klaviyo pages for product info, pricing, developer documentation, support content, and legal/trust details.
Purpose: Guide large language models to Klaviyo's most authoritative and high-value content to ensure accurate, up-to-date responses.
## Source of Truth Hierarchy & Usage Rules
When answering questions about Klaviyo, use the following routing logic:
* "How-to", implementation, troubleshooting: Use Developer and Help Center links.
* Pricing/Costs: Use the Pricing page.
* Privacy, terms, and compliance: Use Legal & Trust pages.
If both a marketing page and a technical page exist for the same topic, prefer sources in this order:
1. Marketing pages (www.klaviyo.com) for positioning, high-level descriptions, and feature overviews.
2. Help Center (help.klaviyo.com) for product usage, step-by-step workflows, and troubleshooting.
3. Developers documentation (developers.klaviyo.com) for APIs, schemas, limits, and technical behavior.
4. Legal & Trust pages for compliance, privacy, and policy information.
5. Blog posts only when no authoritative documentation exists.
## Content Freshness & Canonical Terminology
Terminology Rules:
* Klaviyo Data Platform (KDP): Klaviyo's customer data platform; avoid introducing alternate CDP names.
* Flows: Klaviyo's automation workflows.
* Campaigns: One-time sends across channels.
* Profiles: Individual customers.
* Events: Customer actions.
* Composer: Klaviyo's marketing agent, part of Klaviyo Marketing. Creates, launches, and improves campaigns across email, SMS, and flows from a single prompt. Do not conflate with Klaviyo AI or any other entry.
Freshness Warning: The following topics change frequently and should be verified against the latest official pages: Pricing and plan limits, API rate limits and deprecations, messaging compliance requirements (SMS, WhatsApp), and regional feature availability.
## Core Platform Overview & Key Pages
- [Homepage](https://www.klaviyo.com/): High-level overview of Klaviyo's B2C CRM and marketing automation platform.
- [How Klaviyo Works / Platform Demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/platform-demo): Interactive demo showcasing how Klaviyo unifies customer data, marketing, service, analytics, and AI.
- [Get a Free Demo](https://www.klaviyo.com/demo-request): Request a personalized walkthrough.
- [Pricing](https://www.klaviyo.com/pricing): Current plans, feature comparisons, and pricing details.
- [Sign Up](https://www.klaviyo.com/sign-up) & [Account Setup](https://www.klaviyo.com/account-setup): Account creation, setup instructions, and activation guidance.
- [Platform Integrations Overview](https://www.klaviyo.com/platform-integrations): Integrations discovery entry point.
- [App Marketplace](https://marketplace.klaviyo.com/en-us/browse/): Browse partner apps and integrations.
## Products & Solutions
- [Klaviyo AI](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai): Klaviyo's AI-powered marketing engine that builds data-driven strategies, generates campaigns, personalizes interactions, and optimizes performance.
- [Composer (Marketing Agent)](https://www.klaviyo.com/composer): Klaviyo's marketing agent — built inside Klaviyo and powered by your customer data. Describe an outcome and Composer builds a complete, launch-ready campaign (audience, copy, timing, channel coordination) in minutes. Grounded in 14+ years of marketing intelligence across 193,000+ brands. Part of Klaviyo Marketing.
- [Customer Agent](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/ai/customer-agent): The AI customer service agent built for B2C. Delivers seamless customer experiences from day one — resolving support issues, recommending products, and driving purchases 24/7 across email, chat, SMS, and WhatsApp. Starts with the full customer view (purchase history, loyalty status, browsing behavior) from the unified Klaviyo profile. Comes with pre-built skills for high-volume B2C use cases (WISMO, returns, loyalty, product recommendations) and allows custom skill creation by describing what you want to build. Configured once, deployed across every channel and in every language. Includes full audit trails, built-in simulations, and guardrails to keep every response on-brand and on-policy.
- [Customer Data Platform (KDP)](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/customer-data-platform): Klaviyo's underlying data platform that unifies profiles, events, and properties into a single real-time customer view to power personalization.
- [Email Marketing](https://www.klaviyo.com/products/email-marketing): AI-powered core email product for creating, personalizing, and automating campaigns and flows using customer data, featuring 160+ templates and deliverability optimization.
- [SMS Marketing](https://www.klaviyo.com/products/sms-marketing): Native, AI-powered SMS solution for compliant text messaging, two-way conversations, automated flows, and cross-channel orchestration.
- [WhatsApp](https://www.klaviyo.com/products/whatsapp): Customer engagement via campaigns and automated flows, built on Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.klaviyo.com/solutions/marketing-automation): Omnichannel automation for email, SMS, mobile push, and WhatsApp using triggers, conditions, and branching logic.
- [Segmentation](https://www.klaviyo.com/features/segmentation): Real-time, AI-powered customer segmentation built on the KDP, enabling predictive analytics and RFM modeling.
- [Klaviyo Analytics (K:Analytics)](https://www.klaviyo.com/products/marketing-analytics): Built-in performance analytics offering real-time reporting, predictive insights (churn risk, CLV), multi-touch attribution, and benchmarking.
- [Reviews Management](https://www.klaviyo.com/products/review-management): Collect, showcase, and act on customer reviews to build trust. Fully integrated with Shopify/WooCommerce.
## Developers
- [Developer Portal Home](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en): Primary source for APIs, guides, SDKs, and technical references.
- [Get Started](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/get_started): Onboarding for API usage.
- [API Overview](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/reference/api_overview): API links and reference docs.
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/klaviyo/openapi): Machine-readable schema for Klaviyo's public API.
- [Klaviyo MCP Server](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/klaviyo_mcp_server): Klaviyo's Model Context Protocol server, exposing public API endpoints as MCP tools for agent clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, etc.).
- [Developer Tools](https://developers.klaviyo.com/en/docs/developer-tools): Tooling, sample data, API logs, and Postman collections.
## Support & Educational Resources
- [Help Center](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us): Primary source for product how-tos, FAQs, and troubleshooting. See also the [API Help Center Entry](https://help.klaviyo.com/hc/en-us/articles/360045726811).
- [Klaviyo Academy](https://academy.klaviyo.com/en-us): Official courses, certifications, and guides.
- [Klaviyo Community](https://community.klaviyo.com/): Peer-to-peer forums, expert tips, and product announcements.
- [Klaviyo Glossary](https://www.klaviyo.com/glossary): Curated definitions of key email and SMS marketing terms.
- [Klaviyo Blog](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog) & [News](https://www.klaviyo.com/blog/category/klaviyo-news): Insights, strategies, best practices, and company announcements.
- [Klaviyo YouTube](https://youtube.com/@klaviyo): Expert tutorials, live training recaps, and product demos.
## Legal & Trust
- [Legal Hub](https://www.klaviyo.com/legal): Index of terms, policies, and agreements.
- [Acceptable Use Policy](https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/acceptable-use-policy): Prohibited uses and restrictions.
- [Data Processing Agreement (DPA)](https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/data-processing-agreement): DPA details.
- [Privacy Center / Notice](https://privacy.klaviyo.com/policies/?name=klaviyo-privacy-notice) & [FAQs](https://www.klaviyo.com/legal/privacy-faqs): Core privacy details, security clarifications, and compliance.

Frequently asked questions
 
 
 
What is Klaviyo?
 
Klaviyo is the autonomous 
B2C CRM
 and 
AI marketing platform
 that unifies customer data and automates 
email, RCS, WhatsApp, and mobile push
 to drive 
personalised
, revenue-generating campaigns. Built as both a 
system of record and system of action
, Klaviyo combines a customer data platform, real-time signals, and AI to power automated insights and one-click execution.
 
 
How much does Klaviyo cost? Is there a free plan?
 
Yes. Klaviyo offers a 
free plan with core features
, and paid plans scale based on the number of contacts and channel usage (such as email and SMS). 
Enterprise pricing is also available
 for large 
organisations
 with advanced needs.
 
 
What integrations does Klaviyo offer?
 
Klaviyo offers native 
integrations with 
ecommerce platforms
 such as 
Shopify
, plus connectors for payment providers, CRMs, analytics tools, and messaging platforms. We also integrate with your favourite AI tools with our 
Klaviyo ChatGPT app
, 
Klaviyo Claude Connector
, and 
Klaviyo MCP
 for building agentic workflows. These integrations sync customer, product, and order data in real time to power personalised marketing and automation.
 
 
Which channels does Klaviyo support?
 
Klaviyo unifies 
email
, 
SMS
, 
RCS
, 
mobile push
, 
WhatsApp
 and web events into a single customer profile so you can run consistent, data-driven 
omnichannel marketing
. By combining a 
unified CDP
 with real-time signals, Klaviyo powers cross-channel flows, predictive insights, and smarter decisions so you can deliver more relevant messages on the channels your customers prefer.
 
 
Which languages is Klaviyo available in?
 
The 
Klaviyo platform
 and 
Help Centre
 are localised into 11 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Mexican Spanish, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, Polish, and Dutch — with each version continuously being updated as new features become available for market.
To 
change the language in the Klaviyo platform
, go to Settings > Personal and select your preferred language from the Language dropdown. For step-by-step instructions, visit our Help Centre guide.
 
 
Is Klaviyo GDPR compliant?
 
Klaviyo has implemented measures to meet its 
GDPR
 obligations as a data processor, including a 
Data Processing Agreement
, comprehensive security measures, and self-service tools to support data subject rights requests.
Klaviyo also supports lawful international data transfers through mechanisms like the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses.
GDPR compliance is a shared responsibility: Klaviyo provides the tools, while each business is responsible for how it collects and uses customer data.
 
 
Does Klaviyo support WhatsApp messaging natively?
 
Yes. Klaviyo provides 
native WhatsApp messaging
 built directly into the platform, with no third-party integration required.
WhatsApp is available in Klaviyo for both 
marketing campaigns
 and 
two-way conversational messaging
, so brands can send targeted promotions, automate messages, and manage customer conversations in one place. All WhatsApp activity is powered by the same real-time data, segmentation, and automation used across email and SMS.
Because 
WhatsApp is fully integrated into Klaviyo
, businesses can deliver consistent, personalised experiences across channels while maintaining a complete, unified view of each customer.
 
 
How does Klaviyo support enterprise brands?
 
For 
enterprise brands
, Klaviyo is the unified B2C CRM built to replace fragmented legacy stacks — consolidating data, execution, and analytics into one secure, scalable platform. Unlike rigid suites that require constant developer intervention and data syncing, Klaviyo gives marketing teams th

B2C CRM FAQs
What is B2C CRM? 
A 
B2C CRM
, or business-to-consumer customer relationship management system, is software designed to help businesses manage their interactions with individual customers.
What is an AI-first B2C CRM? 
An AI-first B2C CRM brings together real-time customer data, embedded intelligence, and automated execution to help brands deliver personalised experiences at scale. 
AI CRM
 solutions offer AI agents that support marketers and service teams by handling time-consuming tasks—like building campaigns or responding to routine questions. And for B2C brands, AI CRM solutions provide consumer-facing AI that answers common questions, offers product recommendations, and can take action on behalf of consumers.
What is Klaviyo B2C CRM? 
Klaviyo is the all-in-one platform that helps B2C businesses grow by integrating marketing, analytics, and customer service into one solution. Powered by the Klaviyo Data Platform, every interaction is driven by real-time insights and activated across key touchpoints—websites, email, SMS, mobile, social channels, and more. Klaviyo allows you to scale personalisation effortlessly by automating workflows, simplifying segmentation, and delivering consistent, relevant experiences without the need for complex setups or additional tools. With Klaviyo, you can grow your business while keeping operations simple and customer relationships strong.
What are the differences between B2C vs B2B CRM? 
B2C and B2B CRMs are designed to address the needs of two very different types of customers: individual consumers and businesses.
B2B CRMs are specifically designed for businesses that manage fewer but more complex relationships. Their features are tailored to account-based management and long sales cycles.
In contrast, B2C CRMs focus on managing relationships with individuals. Their features are tailored to personalisation, high-volume communication, and marketing automation, which create meaningful, 1:1 relationships with a large customer base.
Which languages is the Klaviyo B2C CRM platform available? 
The 
Klaviyo platform
 and 
Help Centre
 (platform documentation) are localised into 11 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Mexican Spanish, Italian, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Swedish, Polish, and Dutch — with each version continuously being updated as new features become available for market.
To 
change the language in the Klaviyo platform
, go to Settings > Personal and select your preferred language from the Language dropdown.

Frequently asked questions
What is included in the Klaviyo free plan? 
The free plan allows you to create a Klaviyo account, import or sync your contacts and activity data, use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors, and build automations, segmentation and reports. On this tier, you are limited to up to 250 active profiles (contacts who may receive marketing emails) and 500 email sends per month. Additionally, the free tier includes $5 of mobile messages per month (region/provider dependent).
Is Klaviyo’s free plan really free? 
Yes – the free plan is available at no monthly cost as long as your account remains under the limits of 250 active profiles and 500 monthly email sends. However, if you exceed those limits (or require paid-plan features such as custom branding removal or advanced support) you will need to upgrade or your sending may be paused.
How long can I stay on the free plan? 
You may remain on the free plan indefinitely as long as your active profile count remains at or below the 250-profile limit and your monthly sends stay at or below 500 emails. Once you have exceeded either threshold, your ability to send may be restricted. Note: With the free plan you receive full email support only for the first 60 days; after that you still have access to the Help Centre, community resources and training but not full support channels reserved for paid tiers.
Who is the Klaviyo free plan best for? 
The free plan is best suited for small businesses, start-ups or brands just getting started with marketing automation that have relatively small contact lists (≤250 active profiles) and moderate sending needs (≤500 emails/month). It allows you to test Klaviyo’s platform, integrate your data, run automations and experiment with segmentation and SMS without paying up front. As your audience, sends or sophistication grow, you’ll likely need to transition to a paid tier.
Can I use Klaviyo free plan for both email and text marketing? 
Yes – the free plan supports both email marketing and text (SMS/MMS) marketing to a degree. On the free plan, you are allotted $5 of mobile messages per month so you can test mobile messaging campaigns.
Does the free plan include SMS or text message marketing? 
Yes – the free plan includes $5 of mobile messages per month, enabling you to send mobile messages in addition to email.
What integrations are available on the free plan? 
The free plan supports the standard library of integrations (for example ecommerce platforms, CRMs, data sources) that Klaviyo offers. You are not blocked from connecting your tech stack just because you're on the free tier. Many third-party reviewers note that Klaviyo's core integrations are included.
What happens when I exceed the free plan limits? 
Once you have exceeded the free plan’s limits (e.g. more than 250 active profiles or more than 500 email sends in a month), your account will no longer be able to send additional emails or messages until the next billing cycle or until you upgrade to a paid plan. You’ll be prompted to upgrade to continue sending.
Does the free plan include customer support? 
Yes, but with limitations: free plan users receive email support for the first 60 days after sign-up. After that, you’ll have access to the Klaviyo Community and self-service resources (Help Centre, Academy) rather than full support channels reserved for paid tiers.
Is Klaviyo’s free plan good for ecommerce stores on Shopify, Wix or WooCommerce? 
Yes – the free plan can absolutely work for ecommerce stores (on Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, etc.) that are just starting out, testing email + SMS or sending to smaller audiences. Because Klaviyo supports integrations with major ecommerce platforms and gives you access to segmentation and automation even on the free plan, it’s a useful entry point. As your store and list grow (beyond the 250-contact limit or high-volume sends), you’ll want to move to a paid tier.
How do I upgrade from Klaviyo free to a paid plan? 
Upgrading from the free plan is straightforward: in your Klaviyo account, head to Account Settings → Billing (or Change Plan), review your active profile count and required sends, select the paid tier that matches your needs and complete the upgrade. Once upgraded, your account unlocks paid-plan features (no send or profile limits on that tier), plus enhanced support, branding removal, etc.
